## Provisional Buy
The provisional Buy recommendation is supported primarily by the annual revenue growth of 10.14% for fiscal year 2026 [C:revenue_growth], evidencing strong top-line expansion which outweighs the moderate operating margin of 3.85%.
insight: Insight: Costco shows a notable reduction in long-term debt excluding current portion from $5.713 billion at 2025-08-31 to $3.914 billion at 2026-08-30, a significant deleveraging event [C:long_term_debt_noncurrent] evidenced by the 10-K filing accession 0000909832-26-000093, L000123.
